decision_conditions:
The proposed outbuilding by reason of its excessive mass and bulk
would be a visually obtrusive form of development causing an unacceptable
degree of overbearing, loss of outlook and light for the
neighbouring occupiers Nos 2, 2a, 2b and 6 Eastcote Road contrary to the
high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), Policy D3 D.1, D.7 and D.11 of The London Plan (2021), Core policy CS1B
of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013), and the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010)

<p><span style="font-size: 11pt;">The proposed outbuilding by reason of its excessive depth and height would exceed the 50% allowance of the rear garden space, resulting in an&nbsp;unduly, bulky, disproportionate, incongruous addition,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11pt;">out of character with the prevailing pattern of development in the area, causing visual harm to the character and appearance of the immediate area contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D.1, D.7 and D.11 of The London Plan (2021), Core policy CS1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>
description: Single storey detached outbuilding at rear for use as Gym/Summer house
